final: WITH media_byte_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) as byte_rate FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MediaTypeId), media_price_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), combined_stats AS (SELECT mps.MediaTypeId, mps.avg_price, mbs.byte_rate FROM media_price_stats mps LEFT JOIN media_byte_stats mbs USING (MediaTypeId)), overall_avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_byte_rate FROM combined_stats), filtered_media AS (SELECT cs.avg_price, cs.byte_rate, oar.avg_byte_rate FROM combined_stats cs CROSS JOIN overall_avg_rate oar WHERE cs.byte_rate > oar.avg_byte_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_price) as avg_unit_price, AVG(byte_rate) as avg_byte_rate, AVG(byte_rate - avg_byte_rate) as avg_excess_rate FROM filtered_media
